body:
## Goal
Provide a small, dependency-light JSON HTTP API where users sign up, sign in, and manage their own private notes, with all data surviving a server restart.

## Spec
Built on Node's built-in `http` module (ESM, `"type": "module"`); NO external web framework. Persistence uses an embedded on-disk store — prefer Node's built-in `node:sqlite` (DatabaseSync) against a file, or an equivalent durably-written on-disk store; NOT in-memory. The DB file path is configurable (env, default alongside the app) and gitignored.

Server binds `process.env.PORT` (default 3000). All request/response bodies are JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`).

Endpoints:
- `POST /signup` `{username, password}` → 201 `{id, username}`. Username unique; duplicate → 409. Passwords stored hashed+salted (Node `crypto` scrypt/pbkdf2), never plaintext, never returned.
- `POST /login` `{username, password}` → 200 `{session}` where `session` is an opaque, unguessable token (crypto random) persisted and mapped to the user. Wrong credentials → 401.
- `GET /me` → 200 `{id, username}` for the bearer's user.
- `POST /notes` `{title, body}` → 201 with the created note `{id, title, body, ...}` owned by the bearer's user.
- `GET /notes` → 200 JSON array of ONLY the bearer's notes.

Auth: protected routes read `Authorization: Bearer <session>`; missing/invalid/unknown token → 401. Notes are per-user isolated — a user can never read another user's notes.

Bad requests handled sensibly with proper status + JSON error body: malformed JSON / wrong Content-Type / missing or non-string fields → 400; unknown route → 404; unsupported method → 405. Server never crashes on bad input.

Expose a factory that creates the server without auto-listening, so tests drive it on an ephemeral port with a temp DB file. `npm start` runs the server.

## Changes
- `src/server.js` — creates
- `src/db.js` — creates
- `src/app.js` — creates
- `test/api.test.js` — creates
- `package.json` — refactors-existing
- `.gitignore` — refactors-existing

## Acceptance
- [ ] AC-1: npm start launches an HTTP server on process.env.PORT (default 3000) using only Node built-ins (built-in http; embedded on-disk store, not in-memory) with no external web framework in dependencies
- [ ] AC-2: POST /signup with {username, password} returns 201 and JSON {id, username}; a duplicate username returns 409; a missing/non-string field or malformed JSON returns 400 and the password is never stored in plaintext nor echoed back
- [ ] AC-3: POST /login with valid credentials returns 200 and {session} (an opaque bearer token); invalid credentials return 401
- [ ] AC-4: GET /me with a valid Authorization: Bearer <session> returns 200 {id, username}; a missing or invalid token returns 401
- [ ] AC-5: POST /notes with {title, body} and a valid session returns 201 with the created note owned by that user; GET /notes returns a JSON array of only that user's notes and never another user's notes
- [ ] AC-6: After stopping and restarting the server against the same on-disk store, a previously created user can log in and previously created notes are still listed (data survives restart)
- [ ] AC-7: Unknown routes return 404, unsupported methods return 405, and no malformed request crashes the server

## Verify
- node --test test/api.test.js (e2e)
- npm run typecheck (validate)
- npm run lint (validate)

## Non-Goals
- No external web framework or ORM (Express, Fastify, Koa, better-sqlite3, etc.)
- No session expiry / refresh / logout flow
- No password-strength policy, rate limiting, or account recovery
- No note update or delete endpoints
- No pagination or search on notes
